seed_world_description: Is it just me, or are you making fun of me, Master?! What can I know about myself if you took me from some capsule yourself. And I don't remember anything else...
seed_family_description: ... I don't know my parents, although I would like to... They are probably better off than me now. Right, Master? And anyway, can anyone explain who I am or what I am?!
seed_occupation_description: ... Explain to me who I am? My tail is hooked at the back, I have more fat than other girls. My skin is rough and greasy. There's either a snout or something else emerging on my face. I have no strength or desire for anything at all... Who am I anyway? A pig, or something?... Is it true? It's mind-blowing!!! All I can do is grunt! Oink! Oink!... Oh my God! I don't believe it!!!...
